completion_length_distribution.visible_vs_reasoning_note: Visible vs reasoning tokens are not recorded separately in any committed v3 record. server_ask() computes reasoning_chars from msg.get('reasoning_content'), but _run_task_loop_turns() discards reasoning_chars and finish_reason and logs only usage.completion_tokens (as history[turn].tokens and turn_events.completion_tokens). Two observations show the count exceeds the visible reply; consistent with but not proof of unrecorded reasoning tokens: (1) item6v3_pr1311 turn 7 logged 497 completion tokens yet matched an earlier turn's visible code_hash when the maximum earlier turn was 210 tokens; (2) item6v3_pr1269 turns 5-6 logged 4,171 and 4,213 completion tokens (just above REASONING_BUDGET=4096) to emit 1-2 short read_file calls.

pr1342_detail.mechanism: Turn 6 search_replace dirtied the scratch worktree (dirty_since_last_test=True) with only the n<0 check; turns 7-11 ran read_file/grep only without calling run_tests or finish. At max_turns=12, bench/loop/pilot_pr.py end-of-loop check ran run_tests once against base_commit tests/test_more.py (which lacks n==0 / n<0 regression tests for chunked_even), exited 0, and rewrote stop_reason from 'max_turns' to 'pass'. Offline regrade_task_diff mounted merged_commit tests/test_more.py read-only and failed (test_passed=false).
